name: facet-cpu-game
note: three computer guilds (Hard, Normal, Easy) play a whole game to a legal winner; GL and WebGPU agree on every field; the control deals another table (FACET_SEED) and must end differently

name: facet-idle-seat
note: a Normal guild plays its turn without waiting on anyone, then the person's seat waits: a free pad mashing confirm and right acts for nobody; the control (the seat's own pad picks) must change the table

name: facet-bank-counts
note: every stack in the tray stands as many settings as the rules pile holds, and the number beside it counts to that pile (a label still counting is held to its target); the control is a view whose labels never follow the rules (FACET_TEST_STALE_COUNTS) and must disagree

name: facet-newcomer
note: a newcomer finishes a whole game against an Easy guild with a pad alone, from what the screen offers (romdev, GL and WebGPU); the control, a pad that never confirms, finishes no turn

name: facet-panel-counts
note: every mat shows each colour's card bonuses and loose stones as the rules hold them (a count still counting, or a bonus stone still flying from its card, is held to its target); the control is a view whose mats never follow the rules (FACET_TEST_STALE_PANEL) and must disagree
